description: This course covers pattern programming techniques using formal methods and domain-specific languages. Topics include: regular expressions for text processing; finite automata and their implementation in Java; lexical analysis with Lex and Yacc; parsing techniques such as recursive descent and LL/SLR parsers; design patterns like Singleton and Observer; UML notation for modeling patterns; algorithmic patterns for optimization; and pattern recognition in software systems. Students will learn to apply these concepts through hands-on projects using Java, Python, and standard pattern libraries such as Apache Commons and Spring Framework.

clos.text: Define regular expressions and their role in text processing using Java's Pattern and Matcher classes.
Describe the architecture of finite automata and implement them in Java for string matching applications.
Explain the differences between lexical analysis and parsing, and demonstrate their implementation using Lex and Yacc.
Apply design patterns such as Singleton and Observer in real-world software systems using the Spring Framework.
Design and evaluate algorithmic patterns for performance optimization in distributed computing environments.
